review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Translate product requirements and technical specifications into pragmatic designs that address important edge cases without unnecessary complexity. Build and maintain secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-efficient infrastructure supporting diverse applications and workloads. Manage infrastructure through code and configuration, primarily using Terraform, while maintaining consistency with broader architectural patterns. Partner with product engineering teams to design services for scala
eligibility_evidence: Candidates must be authorized to work from their home location; visa sponsorship is not provided.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Translate product requirements and technical specifications into pragmatic designs that address important edge cases without unnecessary complexity. Partner with product engineering teams to design services for scalability, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and collaborate directly with stakeholders. Requirements 6–10 years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering within primarily cloud-based environments, preferably AWS. T-shaped technical expertise, with deep specialization in one or two infrastructure domains combined with enough breadth to navigate and contribute across the wider technology stack. Strong hands-on experience managing infrastructure through code and configuration using Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure-as-code solution. Hands-on experience operating Redis or ElastiCache in production, including cluster and shard management, fail
